FX-GLARE-001.says: The settings as they start: threshold 80, length 40, points 4, angle 45, intensity 1, white. The yellow, 98 %, and the soft yellow are bright enough; the brown, 60 %, and the purple give no light. Each bright point is streaked along both diagonals, an X, faint as the light is shared over forty steps, running on past the frame; the soft point's streaks are half as strong. The diagonals run between pixel centres, so each streak is spread a little onto the pixels beside its line, and the yellow even takes a little of its own light; pixels well off the diagonals stay as they were.

FX-GLARE-002.says: Intensity 0: the drawing, untouched, and nothing grows.

FX-GLARE-003.says: Length 0.9, floored to 0: no streaks, the drawing untouched.

FX-GLARE-004.says: Threshold 100: nothing is that bright, so the drawing is untouched.

FX-GLARE-005.says: Length 4: the X four pixels long each way, strongest next to the point: the yellow's up-right streak crosses the purple bar at row 1, and pixels further than four steps along a diagonal stay empty.

FX-GLARE-006.says: FX-GLARE-005 at threshold 60: the brown, at exactly 60 %, glints too.

FX-GLARE-007.says: Points 1: one streak from each point, up and to the right, and none the other ways.

FX-GLARE-008.says: Points 2: a single line through each point, up-right and down-left.

FX-GLARE-009.says: Angle 0: a plus, the streaks straight up, right, down and left, each landing on whole pixels: the pixel next to the yellow takes 0.8 squared over 1.2 of its light, and the purple three to its right takes 0.4 squared over 1.2 of it. The diagonal neighbours stay empty.

FX-GLARE-010.says: Angle 90: a quarter turn gives the same four streaks, so it is FX-GLARE-009.

FX-GLARE-011.says: Angle 405, a whole turn past 45: FX-GLARE-005 exactly.

FX-GLARE-012.says: Points 6: a six-pointed star, streaks every 60 degrees from 45.

FX-GLARE-014.says: Intensity 2.5: two and a half times FX-GLARE-005's streaks, not cut off at white; the covering stops at full, so the purple and yellow pixels the streaks cross keep a covering of 1.

FX-GLARE-015.says: Colour #ff8000, orange: FX-GLARE-005's streaks tinted, their red as before, their green a fifth and their blue gone; the covering as FX-GLARE-005's.

FX-GLARE-016.says: FX-GLARE-015 with its colour written in capitals, #FF8000: the same.

FX-GLARE-017.says: Colour #000000, black: the streaks add covering but no colour, a dark cross; the solid pixels they cross keep their colour and the empty ones turn black.

FX-GLARE-018.says: Length keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-GLARE-005, frame 4 is length 8.

FX-GLARE-019.says: Length 4, points keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-GLARE-007, frame 2, at 4.5, is floored to 4 and is FX-GLARE-005, frame 4 is an eight-pointed star.

FX-GLARE-020.says: Length 4, intensity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 10 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 10, is held at 10, and is intensity 10 plain, as frame 4 is.

FX-GLARE-021.says: FX-GLARE-009 moved three pixels right: the layer grew by 4, and the yellow's left streak, which runs two pixels past the drawing's left edge, shows in the two grown columns left of the drawing; column 0, past the streak's end, stays empty.

FX-GLARE-022.says: Threshold 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLARE-023.says: Length 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLARE-024.says: Points 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLARE-025.says: Points 9, above 8. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLARE-026.says: Angle -3601, below -3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLARE-027.says: Intensity keyed to 11 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLARE-028.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLARE-029.says: A colour written "white", a name, not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
